extraction.Name: Julia Harvey
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee for she knew she could not pay the taxes but she took it on the advice of the Farmer
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her land to Peter Deuhamel of Rapid City, So. Dak. for $1400.00, that she could not pay the mortgage so he foreclosed on the land four years ago
extraction.Buyer: Peter Deuhamel of Rapid City, South Dakota — foreclosed on the land four years ago; mortgage amount $1400.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so she mortgaged her land; could not pay the mortgage so he foreclosed
extraction.Occupation/Income: depends on her husband for support who does common labor for a living, making about $300.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: Eight children depending on her for support; received no aid from the Government, State, or County since she was granted a patent; mentally competent, in poor health, and nearly blind; has no land or anything; document signed by husband Joseph Martinez because Julia is so near blind she cannot write; subscribed and sworn before notary by Joseph Martinez, husband, on December 4, 1928; surname also appears as 'Martinez' in document | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area implied)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
